annotations.title: Look up sevDesk ids and codes

description: Look up the ids and codes other sevDesk tools need instead of guessing them: tax_rules (Steuerregeln for Update 2.0, e.g. 1 = steuerpflichtig, 11 = Kleinunternehmer §19), contact_categories (Kunde, Lieferant, …), status_codes (Entwurf, offen, bezahlt per document type), document_types (RE, AN, …), users (SevUser), countries (StaticCountry), units (Einheiten), payment_methods (Zahlungsarten) and receipt_guidance (Kontierungshilfe: which booking account (accountDatev) allows which tax rules and tax rates for expense or revenue receipts (Belege); filter with accountNumber, taxRuleId and receiptType, paged with limit/offset). Use query to filter by a case-insensitive substring of names, codes or ids.

accountNumber.description: receipt_guidance only: exact account number in the chart of accounts.

offset.description: receipt_guidance only: entries to skip; pass the previous nextOffset.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on names, codes and ids, e.g. 'reverse'.

receiptType.description: receipt_guidance only: accounts for expense or revenue receipts.

taxRuleId.description: receipt_guidance only: accounts that allow this tax rule id.

name: sevdesk_reference_lookup
title: Look up sevDesk ids and codes
